TOUGHPOWER GF A3 Gold 1050W ATX 3.1 - TT Premium Edition
TOUGHPOWER GF A3 Gold 1050W ATX 3.1 - TT Premium Edition

Toughpower GF A3 series is 80 PLUS Gold certified and compatible with ATX 3.1 specifications. Designed with a native PCIe Gen 5.1 connector, it can power up next-gen technology with one new 12V-2x6 cable.
Power Up the Next Generation Hardware

To fully support next-gen hardware, Toughpower GF A3 Gold Series (650W/750W/850W/1050W/1200W) is designed to meet ATX 3.1 standards, including a PCIe Gen 5.1 12V-2x6 connector. The GF A3 Gold series delivers 80 PLUS Gold efficiency, it also offers stability, durability, and reliability.

Toughpower GF A3 Gold series is fully compatible with ATX 3.1 Specifications which supports up to 200% power excursion, reaches 60% efficiency at low load and complies with required power supply timing standards.
Toughpower GF A3 Gold series comes with a PCIe 12V-2x6 connector to offer powerful and stable performance allowing the PSU to natively run next-generation GPUs.
The wattage marked on the PCIe 12+4-pin cable connector represents the recommended wattage (Ref. Intel design guideline).
Recommended wattage is an estimation of system power demand. Actual power demands may vary based on specific components, usage, and many other factors.
Please follow the recommended power requirements from the GPU manufactures before using the PCIe 12+4pin cable.
Made to Comply with the Latest Graphics Cards

Ready to supply graphics cards according to their different ways of connections, the Toughpower GF A3 series is designed to support NVIDIA and AMD graphics cards, it supports 8-pin slots for AMD graphics cards & some RTX 40 series graphics cards, it also comes with 1 x 12V-2x6 connector for RTX 40 series cards with a PCIe 12+4pin connector.
Featuring a 120mm fluid bearing fan to deliver excellent airflow. Furthermore, the Smart Zero Fan will the fan will not spin until the load reaches a certain percentage to minimize unwanted noise.
High quality Japanese main capacitor greatly improves the power supplies durability and ensures the Toughpower GF A3 series is stability and reliability.
High Amperage Single +12V Rail & High-Class Technologies

Powerful single +12V rail can properly deliver the power you need for the best compatibility. The use of LLC and DC to DC circuit design provides very stable operation and enhanced voltage regulation.

To protect the hardware, GF A3 is built with industry grade protections: OCP(Over Current Protection), OVP (Over Voltage Protection), UVP(Under Voltage Protection), OPP(Over Power Protection), SCP(Short Circuit Protection), OTP(Over Temperature Protection).
Offers cable selection for users while powering the system at an advantageous voltage. Low-profile black cables make cable management easier, reduces clutter and increases airflow inside the chassis.
80 PLUS Gold Certified and Intel C6/C7 States Ready

Toughpower GF A3 Gold series saves energy through its high energy efficiency up to 90% and is certified to 80 PLUS® Gold. It has been optimized to work with all generations of Intel’s processors to achieve maximum energy saving.
